items.passage: Mr. Lin is a cook. He works in a restaurant and makes noodles and soup. His wife is a nurse. She helps sick people at the hospital. Their son wants to be a police officer because he likes to help people. On Sunday, the family eats dinner together at home.
items.advPassage: Last week, Lily visited a farm with her class. A farmer showed them the cows and chickens. They picked apples and fed the animals. At noon, they ate lunch under a big tree. Lily was happy because she saw a baby cow. She wants to be a farmer one day.
